chunks: My father (may Allah have mercy on him) said: Sa'd ibn Abdillah narrated to me from Ya'qub ibn Yazid from Muhammad ibn Abi Umayr from Abdillah ibn Muskan from Muhammad ibn Muslim who said:

I asked Abu Ja'far (peace be upon him) regarding the saying of Allah, the Mighty and Majestic: 'They shall have that whereof they were niggardly made to cleave to their necks on the resurrection day.'

He (a.s.) said: 'There is no servant who withholds even a little of the Zakat of his wealth, except that Allah will make it for him on the Day of Resurrection a serpent of fire, a collar around his neck, which gnaws his flesh until he finishes the reckoning.'

And this is His saying, the Mighty and Majestic: 'They shall have that whereof they were niggardly made to cleave to their necks on the resurrection day.' He said: 'That which they were niggardly of is the Zakat.'
ai.seo_question: What does the verse 'Sayuttaqquuna ma bakhilu bihi' refer to regarding Zakat?
ai.summary: In Thawab al-A'mal, Shaykh al-Saduq records Imam al-Baqir (a.s.) interpreting the verse 'They shall have that whereof they were niggardly made to cleave to their necks' as a specific reference to the withholding of Zakat. The Imam elucidates that the withheld wealth transforms into a fire serpent that encircles the neck and gnaws the flesh of the sinner during the Day of Judgment until the accounting is complete. This narration underscores the tangible, physical consequences of stinginess in Shia eschatology, linking material hoarding directly to spiritual torment.

en.sayed-athar-husain-rizvi-&-sayed-maqs: 1. My father (rah) said: it was narrated to me by Sa’d b. Abdillah from Ya’qub b. Yazid from Muhammad b. Abi ’Umayr from Abdillah b. Muskan from Muhammad b. Muslim who said:
The narrator asked Imam Muhammad Baqir (a.s.) regarding the verse: they shall have that whereof they were niggardly made to cleave to their necks on the resurrection day.

Imam (a.s.) replied, “For one who does not pay Zakat from his wealth, the Almighty Allah will make a serpent of fire from that wealth and put it around the neck of that person on the Day of Judgment. This serpent will sting the person continuously till the time he is giving account of his deeds.
According to that verse, acting miserly in spending wealth means non payment of Zakat.”
